'''Breerdin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] agency during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Breerdin tasked an Imperial-aligned individual to help him stop an incident between the Empire and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]. The individual was sent by the officer to plant evidence in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] security system to implicate the [[Balmorran resistance]]'s involvement.
